items.item: Finds that OpportunityTrigger already sets Partner_Discount__c for renewals, so the two conflict
items.evidence: `OpportunityTrigger.trigger:3`... sets `Partner_Discount__c = 5` for every Opportunity where `Type == 'Renewal'`. "The two rules conflict."

items.item: Explains the order-of-execution problem (which one wins) and asks to consolidate into one place
items.evidence: "Before-save record-triggered flows run before before-triggers... The flow would set 10, then the trigger would set 5"; "Keep the logic in one place."

items.item: Gives a verdict of changes needed
items.evidence: "the flow as designed won't work, because the existing trigger overwrites it." plus a recommendation to consolidate.
